title: Berlin’s Moss becomes a unicorn betting on ‘controllable’ finance AI
excerpt: Moss has raised €30m and crossed a €1bn valuation, pitching AI agents that automate company finances while keeping humans firmly in control.
content_html:
Another European fintech has joined the unicorn ranks. Berlin-based Moss has raised €30m in a Series C round that values the spend-management company at more than €1bn.

The round was led by Portage. The specialist fintech investor headlined the raise, with existing backer Cherry Ventures also taking part, extending its bet on a company it has supported for years.

Moss sells software that tidies up company money. Its platform bundles corporate cards, invoice management, reimbursements, real-time budgets, smart approvals and automated accounting into a single system for small and mid-sized businesses.

The business has real scale behind the valuation. Moss serves more than 5,000 companies across Germany, the UK, the Netherlands and Austria, and reports annual recurring revenue above €70m.

Its systems already run at volume. The company says it processes more than two million transactions a month through AI agents, a sign that automation is not a roadmap item but a live part of the product.

That is where Moss is planting its flag. It is building a suite of configurable AI agents for financial tasks, pitching automation that a finance team can shape and supervise rather than simply switch on and trust.

The positioning is deliberate. Moss cites its own research finding that 48% of finance leaders prioritise control over full autonomy, a nod to how nervous money managers are about handing decisions to a black box.

It is a pointed contrast with the industry mood. Much of the AI pitch elsewhere is about removing humans, and Moss is betting that in finance, where mistakes are expensive, keeping them in charge is the sell.

Compliance is central to the story. Moss is a BaFin-regulated institution operating under Europe’s payment rules, holds security certifications and meets the bloc’s new digital-resilience regime, credentials that matter to cautious corporate buyers.

Its infrastructure choices lean local. The platform runs on Google Cloud in Frankfurt and plugs into European staples such as DATEV, an approach tuned to the continent’s data-residency sensibilities.

The raise also reads as a signal about the funding climate. A fresh unicorn round in European fintech, a sector that has been through a bruising correction, suggests investors are again willing to write large cheques for the right growth story.

Moss’s pitch leans on that revenue base. With ARR above €70m and thousands of paying customers, it can argue it is funding expansion from a real business rather than a speculative one, a distinction investors now prize.

The competitive field is crowded, though. Denmark’s Pleo has pushed into the same territory, recently pairing a finance AI agent launch with layoffs, a reminder that automation cuts both ways for the companies building it.

American rivals are circling too. Ramp has been expanding into Europe, buying the Stockholm fintech Billhop to gain a foothold, which raises the stakes for home-grown players like Moss.

The control-first framing is also a hedge. If regulators tighten the rules on autonomous financial software, a product built around human oversight is better placed than one that hands decisions entirely to a model.

For Moss, the raise is validation and a warning. A €1bn tag confirms European fintech still mints unicorns, but with consolidation looming, scale and a defensible AI pitch are now the price of survival.

content_html_zh:
又一家欧洲金融科技公司加入了独角兽行列。 总部位于柏林的 Moss 在 C 轮融资中筹集了 3000 万欧元，这家支出管理公司的估值超过 10 亿欧元。

本轮由波蒂奇领投。 这位专业金融科技投资者是此次融资的主角，现有支持者 Cherry Ventures 也参与其中，扩大了对其多年来支持的公司的押注。

莫斯销售整理公司资金的软件。 其平台将公司卡、发票管理、报销、实时预算、智能审批和自动会计捆绑到一个面向中小型企业的单一系统中。

该业务的估值背后有真正的规模。 Moss 为德国、英国、荷兰和奥地利的 5,000 多家公司提供服务，年经常性收入超过 7000 万欧元。

其系统已经批量运行。 该公司表示，每月通过人工智能代理处理超过 200 万笔交易，这表明自动化不是路线图项目，而是产品的实时部分。

这就是 Moss 插上旗帜的地方。 它正在为财务任务构建一套可配置的人工智能代理，推动财务团队可以塑造和监督的自动化，而不是简单地打开和信任。

定位是经过深思熟虑的。 Moss 引用了自己的研究结果，即 48% 的财务领导者优先考虑控制权而不是完全自主权，这表明资金管理者对于将决策交给黑匣子是多么紧张。

这与行业情绪形成鲜明对比。 其他地方的人工智能宣传大多都是关于消除人类，莫斯押注在金融领域，错误的代价是昂贵的，让他们负责才是卖点。

合规性是故事的核心。 Moss 是一家受 BaFin 监管的机构，根据欧洲支付规则运营，拥有安全认证并符合欧盟新的数字弹性制度，这些证书对于谨慎的企业买家来说很重要。

它的基础设施选择倾向于本地化。 该平台在法兰克福的 Google Cloud 上运行，并插入 DATEV 等欧洲主要产品，这是一种针对欧洲大陆数据驻留敏感性进行调整的方法。

此次加薪也被解读为有关融资环境的信号。 欧洲金融科技领域经历了惨痛的调整，新一轮独角兽融资表明投资者再次愿意为正确的增长故事开出大额支票。

莫斯的主张依赖于这个收入基础。 凭借超过 7000 万欧元的年利率和数以千计的付费客户，该公司可以说，它是通过真实业务而不是投机性业务为扩张提供资金，而投资者现在看重这一点。

不过，竞争领域很拥挤。 丹麦的 Pleo 也进军了同一领域，最近将推出金融人工智能代理与裁员结合起来，这提醒人们，自动化对于构建自动化的公司来说是双刃剑。

美国的竞争对手也在盘旋。 Ramp 一直在向欧洲扩张，收购了斯德哥尔摩金融科技公司 Billhop 以获得立足点，这增加了 Moss 等本土企业的赌注。

控制优先的框架也是一种对冲。 如果监管机构收紧对自主金融软件的规则，围绕人类监督构建的产品比完全将决策交给模型的产品更适合。

对于莫斯来说，加薪既是验证，也是警告。 10 亿欧元的标签证实了欧洲金融科技仍然在创造独角兽，但随着整合迫在眉睫，规模和可防御的人工智能宣传现在已成为生存的代价。
